exceptions.reason: Next 15.5.23 declares sharp ^0.34.3 and npm only offers a breaking Next 16 upgrade; forcing sharp 0.35 outside Next's supported range is not a safe patch for this repair.
exceptions.reachability: Sharp is present in the packaged Next standalone runtime, but next/image is disabled and application/runtime code has no direct sharp import or call site. Build/test scripts use Sharp for repository-controlled media and asset checks; no product runtime libvips decode path has been identified.
